svg.title: Illustrative Azure Retirement Readiness dashboard
svg.desc: Illustrative example with synthetic data for the Contoso-Platform-Production subscription, evidence date September 25, 2026. KPI tiles: 126 ARM resources scanned; next deadline in 46 days because Azure Functions support for .NET 8 ends November 10, 2026; 4 resources to validate now (1 Bing grounding account and 3 Azure Bot Service resources); 0 legacy ARM types. Retirement queue: P0 orders-api, an Azure Functions Flex Consumption app on .NET 8 isolated, to be upgraded to .NET 10 isolated by November 10, 2026; P1 web-grounding, a Grounding with Bing Custom Search resource to validate after the Bing Search APIs retired August 11, 2025; P1 three Azure Bot Service resources (customer-support-bot, claims-assistant, field-service-bot) needing source-code assessment because Bot Framework SDK support tickets are no longer serviced as of December 31, 2025; P2 orders-insights, workspace-based Application Insights with no migration required. The direct subscription Owner is the Platform Operations Team, platform-operations@contoso.example. No exportable Service Health events or Service Health alerts were found, which is reported as a coverage gap. A four-phase migration plan runs from day 0 to day 46.
